events.title: Kalbid army defeats Emperor Otto II at Stilo
events.description: The forces of the Kalbid emir of Sicily routed Otto II's army near Stilo in Calabria, though the emir himself was killed. Otto barely escaped by swimming to a ship, and his plans to conquer southern Italy collapsed.

events.title: William the Lion of Scotland is captured at Alnwick
events.description: English knights surprised King William I of Scotland in fog outside Alnwick and took him prisoner. To win his release he accepted the Treaty of Falaise, submitting Scotland to Henry II's overlordship.

events.title: Congress passes the Northwest Ordinance
events.description: The Confederation Congress set out how lands north-west of the Ohio River would be governed and admitted as new states. It also banned slavery there, shaping the pattern of American westward expansion.

events.title: Queen Victoria moves into Buckingham Palace
events.description: Three weeks after her accession, 18-year-old Victoria became the first monarch to live at Buckingham Palace. It has been the sovereign's principal London residence ever since.
events.html: Three weeks after her accession, 18-year-old Victoria became the first monarch to live at Buckingham Palace. It has been the sovereign's principal London residence ever since.

events.title: The Treaty of Berlin redraws the map of the Balkans
events.description: The Congress of Berlin recognised the independence of Serbia, Montenegro and Romania and cut back the large Bulgaria created by Russia. Its compromises left grievances that fed later Balkan wars.

events.title: The Hollywoodland sign is dedicated in Los Angeles
events.description: A giant sign reading 'Hollywoodland' was unveiled in the hills above Los Angeles to advertise a housing development. Shortened to 'Hollywood' in 1949, it became a global symbol of the film industry.
